dialogue: The calendar is filled to the brim with activities, mostly corporate events or activities.
"Atman manager ball", "management development class", "Pickleball with DBO"...
"Racketball with main branch Operations Supervisor", "golf with assistant VP", "Tennis with company tennis team"...
This computer belongs to your manager?
Are you sure he isn't a god?
His schedule lacks sleep humans need.
Nah, he's human.
People are just idiotic and care more about bootlicking to social climb than sleeping.
Doesn't surprise me though.
He always looks wired and jittery.
Today on the calendar is labeled with 2 things.
My birthday..?
Why would he label my birthday?
Ooo maybe he's crushing on you and was planning a surprise for you.
Hah, no way.
He ignores me or treats me like a bug on his shirt most of the time.
Weird.
Yeah, weird...
And it looks like he already has someone.
Today is also labeled:
"Celebration dinner with Maggie :]"
Oh, how sweet.
I don't even know how he has time for a girlfriend with this schedule.
Well, that dinner isn't happening.
Guess it isn't.
